faults.title: Squealing brakes
faults.description: Some 2014–2021 C-Class cars have been reported with brakes that squeal and are difficult to quieten. Check braking performance and have the system inspected rather than treating persistent noise as harmless.

faults.title: Infotainment and navigation glitches
faults.description: Owners have reported electrical problems affecting the W205 infotainment or satnav. Test the display and navigation during a drive and check for software or hardware faults if the issue repeats.
